facts.en: Completed a spreadsheet workshop in 2023-11; no external certification was issued.
facts.zh: 2023-11 完成电子表格工作坊；未颁发外部认证。

facts.en: Service intake assistant at Fictional Parcel Lantern, 2020-09 to 2023-06.

facts.en: Service operations coordinator at Fictional Parcel Lantern, 2023-07 to 2026-09.

facts.en: Maintains request status and routes exceptions to service leads using an approved routing sheet.

facts.en: The active queue held 43 requests in 2026-09; the 2025-12 peak snapshot held 76, not an annual total.
facts.zh: 2026-09 活跃队列有 43 个请求；2025-12 高峰快照为 76 个，并非全年总量。

facts.zh: 2025-02 与服务负责人共同设计请求完整度检查。

facts.en: Personally built spreadsheet dropdowns and reminder flags; the lead approved routing categories.
facts.zh: 个人制作电子表格下拉列表及提醒标记；分派类别由负责人批准。

facts.en: A 2025-04 check found complete owner fields in 27 of 32 sampled requests, compared with 18 of 30 in 2025-01; samples differed.
facts.zh: 2025-04 检查发现，抽样 32 个请求中有 27 个责任人字段完整；2025-01 抽样 30 个中为 18 个；样本不同。

facts.en: Drafted a self-service intake form in 2026-05; it was not released by 2026-09.
facts.zh: 2026-05 起草自助受理表；截至 2026-09 未发布。

facts.en: Uses spreadsheet filters, shared inbox tags, and documented escalation notes.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格筛选、共享收件箱标签及有记录的升级处理笔记。

facts.en: Communicates status updates without promising resolution dates beyond the lead-approved schedule.
facts.zh: 传达状态更新，不承诺超出负责人批准排期的解决日期。

facts.en: Built a personal aquarium feeding log in 2024-08; it was unrelated to service queues.
facts.zh: 2024-08 制作个人水族箱喂养日志；与服务队列无关。

facts.en: An unsigned handover says queue owner, but the approved role record describes coordinator support; final ownership is unclear.

facts.en: A course reminder mentions SQL training but has no attendance record; completion is unconfirmed.
facts.zh: 一条课程提醒提及 SQL 培训，但无出勤记录；完成情况未经确认。

facts.en: No resolution-time reduction, cost savings, or revenue effect was measured for the completeness check.
